links.outcome: Model performance across datasets (sites) in leave-one-dataset-out validation for ischemia detection
links.effect: AUC exceeded 0.90 within the same dataset, but performance dropped notably on data from different sources; sensitivity decreased substantially while specificity remained relatively stable.
links.quote: However, performance dropped notably when the models were tested on data from different sources.

links.outcome: Effect of dataset shift between development and external datasets on model performance
links.effect: Variations in ECG patterns across datasets contributed to performance drops; sensitivity decreased substantially when tested on different datasets.
links.quote: Further analysis showed that variations in ECG patterns across datasets contributed to these differences in performance.

screen.reason: Empirical multi-database benchmark evaluating how domain shift and dataset heterogeneity affect ML model generalizability for ECG ischemia detection.
